handover.bodyIntro: This handover protocol documents the delivery procedures for client {clientName} regarding unit {unitCode} at project {projectName}, in accordance with NJD Development policies and the signed sale contract.
handover.bodyClause1: The client acknowledges reviewing the unit condition, attached specifications, and any documented reservations at the time of signing this protocol.
handover.bodyClause2: Both parties agree that any outstanding finishing, legal, or financial matters recorded in the CRM system remain governed by the master contract and applicable Egyptian real estate regulations.
handover.bodyClause3: This document is generated electronically from the NJD Post-Sales CRM and serves as an official internal handover record pending final countersignature.

auth.scanQr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
auth.verify2faHint: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.) and enter the current 6-digit code.
auth.verifyTip1: Codes change every 30 seconds — wait for a fresh code and try again.
auth.verifyTip2: Make sure your phone date/time is set to automatic (network time).
auth.verifyTip3: Open the NJD CRM entry in your app — not an old or duplicate account.

verifyErrors.NOT_CONFIGURED: Two-factor authentication is not set up on your account. Use the button below to scan a new QR code.
verifyErrors.INVALID_CODE: That code was rejected. Wait for the next code in your app, confirm the NJD CRM account is selected, and try again.

auth.manualStep1: Open Google Authenticator → tap + → Enter a setup key

auth.manualStep4: Choose Time based → Save, then enter the 6-digit code below
auth.manualTip: If the code is rejected, check your phone's date/time is set to automatic, then tap Retry QR or refresh this page once.

requirements: Review the current status notes and identify the requested action

closeSteps: Complete the follow-up described in the case notes
Change status to Engineering or Legal if another team must act
Mark as Resolved when the client request is fully completed

requirements: Review the legal note and any warning or dispute details
Escalate to management or legal counsel as required
closeSteps: Document actions taken on the unit timeline
Keep status as Legal while the dispute is active
Mark as Resolved only after legal/management confirms closure

requirements: Review the technical or snagging issue in the case notes
Coordinate with the engineering / site team for inspection or repair
closeSteps: Record inspection results on the unit timeline
Update status when work is scheduled or completed
Mark as Resolved after the client accepts the fix

requirements: Review the case notes and confirm what the client needs

closeSteps: Add progress notes on the unit timeline
Update the ticket status to match the current stage
